reviewMethod: Agent manual comparison of all 40 public reference/transcript pairs; punctuation/number formatting inspected separately. No human or blinded rating claimed.
scope: 20 known synthetic Samantha TTS fixtures replayed twice; not held-out human speech and not microphone/stop-to-final latency.
prepareCaveat: First prepare in this test process; OS/CoreML caches uncontrolled; prepare includes internal warmup
timingMethod: ContinuousClock file-recovery durations. p50 midpoint median; p95/p99 nearest rank. n=10 per group makes tail percentiles maxima and directional only. Initial short includes first replay.
qualitySummary: No negation flip, number magnitude change, lost final words or reordered/lost sentence content observed in this limited corpus.
Repeated lexical/entity/correction/address defects in fixtures 01,02,06,19; fixture12 adds currency notation needing review.
Raw ASR preservation must not be scored against cleanup references; no normalized WER or comparable baseline was computed.
No real clipped-endpoint/drain, silence, microphone, streaming, resource, or destination gate established.
